about_short_description.short_description: Velents provides a platform that uses artificial intelligence to match job candidates with relevant career opportunities.

product.name: AI Recruiter
product.description: An AI-powered recruitment platform for screening resumes, conducting candidate interviews, evaluating skills, and ranking applicants against job requirements.

product.name: Velents AI Platform
product.description: An Arabic-focused enterprise AI platform for automating operational workflows, connecting business systems, and supporting data-informed decisions for governments and organizations.

product.name: Velents Agents (AI Agents)
product.description: A suite of AI agents that handles voice calls, knowledge-based questions, conversational support, candidate screening, and coordination of automated business tasks.

product.name: Velents API
product.description: API services for embedding Velents AI capabilities into existing applications, including video transcription, text analysis, content matching, personality and emotion analysis, and conversational AI.

product.name: Velents Assess
product.description: A skills-assessment solution for measuring candidates’ technical, functional, cognitive, behavioral, and personality attributes during recruitment and workforce development.

product.name: Velents Agent
product.description: An AI productivity and meeting-assistance product that transcribes meetings, summarizes discussions, documents outcomes, and makes records searchable.
